summary: Strong workflow and module design, solid PowerShell conventions, least-privilege permissions. Key issues: (1) test harness copies `.actrc` without checking existence — will crash if missing (line 44); remove it or add Test-Path validation. (2) Repeated assertion pattern in harness (exit code, output match, job check) for each case could factor into helper. (3) Test files referenced in workflow (./tests) not provided; unclear if TDD requirement was fulfilled. Otherwise excellent error handling, clear naming, good separation of concerns.
